a wave carrying both walls at once, driven end to end

summary: A wave that hit a slot-leg throw and a ledger-refusing merge reports no ledger class: `slotError` is read first and `WaveMerge.refusal` reaches no surface

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: A fanout wave whose merge stage recorded a pending-ledger refusal leaves as the `WaveLedgerRefusal` it recorded even when a slot leg also threw, so `tickExitCode` (`src/cliVerdict.ts`) exits `EX_MOUNT_DEAD` over a parse failure instead of the widest arm's 1. A wave carrying only one of the two walls keeps the class it reports today.
tests: a wave whose merge stage refused its ledger rewrite reports that refusal when a slot leg also threw
notes: `waveMergeError` (`src/waveMerge.ts:1119`) already prefers the refusal the stage recorded over its holder's own cause; the wave leg does not. `src/waveTick.ts:697` reads `slotError` before `:715` reads `mergeError`, so a recorded `WaveMerge.refusal` reaches no surface and `TickOutcome.ledgerRefusal` is absent. Lever: a slot whose `settleSlot` teardown throws while a sibling pick's rewrite reads an unparseable queue.
